tei:div.tei:p: rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi mdzad rnam mdor bsdus/

rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas mchog ni bod rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags sprel spyi lo 1800lor mdo khams zla rgyal 'phen phyug gi nye zhol/ dge mang skam chung zhes par yab smug po rigs dge rtse tshe dbang nor bu dang*/ yum karma chos sgron gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ sku na phra mo'i dus nas dad pa dang dag snang che zhing lhag par du snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud brlan pa zhig tu bzhugs/ bka' 'gyur ba chos kyi blo gros kyis rje gter bdag gling pa'i rnam sprul bka' 'gyur pa chen po mkhas grub bkra shis rgya mtsho'i yang srid du mnga' gsol mdzad/ de nas sngags ston smon lam dar rgyas las yi ge 'bri klog dang*/ brda sprod sum rtags snyan gsum/ rtsis rig sogs thun mong gi rig gnas dang*/ yon tan mdzod sogs gzhung bshad du ma gsan sbyangs gnang*/ de nas 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu'i zhabs la gtugs te blo sbyong gi skor rnams gsan pas/ bskal ba du mar byang chub kyi sems la goms pa'i rigs sad de/ 'khor ba la nges 'byung dang*/ sems can la snying rje gnyis po phan tshun 'gran pa lta bu'i rgyud dbang med du 'khul te/ 'jig rten srid pa'i phun tshogs mtha' dag la zhen pa gting nas log ste/ 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi bya ba thams cad rgyab tu bskyur nas/ sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs te rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa/ grub thob rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gong ma rnams kyi rjes su snyegs pa zhig byed dgongs pa'i thugs bzhed nar mar yod thog /gling grub chen bsod nams sbyin pa'i drung nas bstan pa la 'jug pa'i sgo yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa gsan zhing smin grol gyi gdams pa'ang mang du gsan/ mkhas grub 'jigs med ngo mtshar las rnying ma rgyud 'bum dang*/ mang dge rab 'byams pa dge legs yar 'phel las byang chub lam rim chen mo sogs gsan/

de nas grub dbang byang chub rdo rje'i zhabs la gtugs te/ smin grol gyi gdams pa mtha' dag lhag lus med par bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang zhing*/ bdag la gzhan phan byang chub sems kyi rgyud pa ma nyams pa zhig yod pa 'di khyod kyis 'dzin par re'o gsungs nas/ nges don gyi rgyal ba'i gdung tshab tu mnga' gsol te/ mtshan yang rgyal ba'i sras po gzhan phan mtha' yas 'od zer zhes gsol/ de nas gzhon nu 'jigs med skal bzang las/ dpal gsang ba snying po'i bshad pa dang*/ sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dbang dang gdams khrid kyi skor gsan/ gzhan yang bshes mang po'i mdun/ gtum mo rtsa rlung gi skor 'ga' zhig dang*/ na ro chos drug /gcod yul sogs zab rgyas kyi gdams ngag mang po gsan/ de nas tshe rabs mang po'i rig bdag rdo grub 'jigs med 'phrin las 'od zer zhabs la btugs te/ lo gsum gyi ring brnyes pa gsum gyis bsnyen nas mdo sngags spyi dang*/ khyad par du 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhung bshad man ngag mtha' dag bum pa gang byos kyis rdzogs par gsan te/ thugs nyams su bzhes pas sku lus la grib ma med pa dang*/ khang khyim sogs gdos bcas kun la thogs med zang thal du gshegs bzhud mdzad pa sogs/ 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam las spang rtogs kyi yon tan mtha' dag mngon du gyur/ dam pa 'di nyid snga mar tshangs spyod rnam dag gos dkar lcang lo'i cha byad du bzhugs shing*/ nges med kyi gnas su sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i dgongs pa mnga' la/ rtsa rlung dang bskyed rdzogs la nus pa thon zhing brtul zhugs chen po dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sa gnon nges shig yin na yang*/ re zhig sngar gyi jo 'brom yab sras kyi dgongs bzhed ltar/ rang rang so so'i nyams len la gsang sngags las zab pa med cing*/ gcig pur dben pa bsten na grub 'bras re mngon du 'gyur mod kyi/ bstan 'gro spyi la mdo sngags bshad sgrub cig 'dzugs par phan thogs che bar dgongs shing*/

lha dang bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskul ma yang yang zhus pa bcas kyis/ bstan pa spyi'i 'jug srol gyi rim pa sngar chos rgyal chen pos bkas bcad pa ltar spyod pa mkhan po'i lugs/ lta ba klu sgrub kyi lugs/ nyams len pad+ma dang bi ma'i lugs ltar gsang sngags la byas na/ snga 'gyur ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid dus kyi mthar yang cung zhig dar rgyas su 'gyur snyam pa thugs la bzhag ste/ dpal sprul rin po che sogs dam pa du mas sngags spyod kyis zab gter bzhes na/ sku tshe dang gter gyi phrin las mthar phyin tshul gsol ba btab kyang ma gsan par/ rdzogs chen mkhan rin po che seng phrug pad+ma bkra shis las gsol bzhi'i las kyis bsnyen par rdzogs nas/ 'dul ba'i gnang bkag la tshul bzhin du bslab pas rang bzhin ngang gis nyes ltung phra mos kyang ma gos pa 'phags pa nye ba 'khor dang mtshungs par mdzad/ gzhung lugs rnams kyi zab don la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i rnam dpyod rlabs che ba thob pas/ snga 'gyur rang lugs kyi lta grub zab mo'i khyad par 'dzin pa la rgol ba gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed pa'i spobs pa rdo rje lta bu thob/ sa dge sogs dge bshes mkhas pa du ma dang 'bel ba'i gtam byas pa tsam nas/ rmad du byung ba'i mkhas pa chen por nges pa rnyed de zhabs kyi pad+mo gus pas dang du len pa byung*/ stod kyi gangs dkar ti se nas smad rgya nag glang chen 'gying ri'i bar/ gnas chen gangs brag mtsho sogs nges med kyi dben khrod du mar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs te nyams bzhes mthar phyin mdzad/ rtag tu rgyal bstan lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che kho na thugs la bcangs te dbus gtsang phyogs su lan gnyis phebs te rgyud stod mkhan po dge 'dun dar rgyas las/ byams chos sde lnga dang*/ dbu ma rig pa'i tshogs drug sogs 'phags yul mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rgyun yod do cog thams cad dang*/

o rgyan smin grol gling gi rdor 'dzin mkhan po 'gyur med mi pham dpal bzang po las rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur chen mo yongs rdzogs/ lha lung pad ri sprul sku las gshin rje gdong drug dang*/ mi tra brgya rtsa sogs kyi skor/ smin gling khri chen las gter chen bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs/ na len+d+ra'i gzims 'og sprul sku'i mdun ba ri brgya rtsa dang*/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ yongs 'dzin dam pa byams pa 'phrin las las mdun kyai rdor rgyud dbang dang*/ lam 'bras kyi skor sogs sa dge bka' rnying kun gyi mkhas grub brgya phrag tsam gyi zhabs la gtugs te/ bka' bstan gyis mtshon gangs ljongs bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad po so so'i bzhed srol ji snyed pa'i dbang lung gi rgyun rnams gsan bzhes mdzad/ de yang rje 'di sku na chung ngu'i dus ri kha la rtsed mor g.yeng ba'i skabs shig tu/ bsam yas me 'jigs bzlog tshul gyi kha byang phyag tu 'byor yang btang snyoms su lus pa/ phyis bsam yas mes 'jigs pa byung ba gsan pas thugs 'gyod chen po gnang*/ yang lha sar chu 'jigs bzlog pa'i lung byang yod pa bzhin de don su la'ang ma gsungs par sbas tshul gyis/ chos rgyal chen po'i sgrub gnas pho brang khar zhag bdun phrag gsum ring phyag rdor dregs 'dul gyi ljags bsnyen gnang ba sogs lung byang rnams ma yol bar bsgrubs pas/ de skabs lha sar chu gnod chen po byung yang bzlog par gyur pa sogs/ rgyal dbang pad ma'i 'phrin las kyi byed po gter ston chen po'i skal ba can zhig tu bzhugs/ de nas grub dbang chen po'i 'byung 'gyur gyi lung byang las/ de phyir na ru dam dben par/ /'du 'dzi yi spros pa bcad bzhin/ /bskyed rdzogs la brtson pa bskyed na/ /gzugs can dang gzugs med 'gro ba/ /phal mo che gdul byar 'gyur zhing*/ /rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhan cig /'grub nges pa pad+ma'i bkar mtshungs/

/zhes sogs lung bstan pa bzhin ru dam gyi dben gnas rnams su sgrub pa rtse gcig mdzad par bzhed de phebs pas/ gdan sa chen po o rgyan bsam gtan chos gling du rdzogs pa chen po chos nyid mngon sum la dbang 'byor ba grub pa'i dbang phyug mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje dang mjal/ der 'dus pa mdo dbang chen mo dang*/ zab gsang mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dbang lung khrid dang bcas pa zhib rgyas su gsan/ gshin rje phug dang tshe ring phug sogs su sgrub pa mdzad de bzhugs pa'i bar skabs rnams la/ mchog sprul rin po che'i zhal snga nas rje 'di nyid la dgon 'dir bshad sgrub kyi srol ka re btod rgyu byung na legs tshul gyi gsung nan yang yang phebs par brten/ gzhis byes kyi bla sprul dang grwa tshang bcas khyon brgya skor tsam la mdo sngags smon lam/ yon tan mdzod/ sdom gsum rnam nges/ dpal gsang ba snying po sogs gdul bya'i blo dang 'tsham par lung rigs kyi lam nas nges pa 'drong ba'i bshad pa gting tshugs pa mdzad de/ gnas skabs mthar thug kun tu phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gzhi ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che kho na la rag las shing*/ de nyid yun ring du gnas par byed pa la bshad sgrub gal che bar dgongs nas/ bshad grwa gsar 'dzugs kyis gnas gzhi gzigs su phebs skabs/ dag pa'i gzigs snang la rgya gar gyi paṇa chen shrī sidha gnas der bzhugs pa mjal bas der mdo khams rdzogs chen shrī sidha chos grwa chen mo zhes/ dpal nā len+d+ra gnyis pa lta bu'i chos sde chen po zhig rdzogs sprul bzhi pa mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje dang lhan du gsar bskrun gnang ste/ der 'dul ba gzhi gsum gyi phyag len gzhir bzhag thog snga 'gyur nang rgyud sde gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i bshad rgyun btsugs te/ mkhan rab thog mar rgyal ba'i sras po gzhan phan mtha' yas 'od zer mchog dang*/

des dpal sprul 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po dang*/ mkhan chen pad+ma rdo rje rnam gnyis/ de gnyis kas 'jam mgon mi pham rin po che dang*/ gzhan phan chos kyi snang ba sogs kyis slob brgyud yang brgyud dang bcas pas 'dzam gling tha gru gang sar khyab pa'i 'phrin las bskyangs/ /de yang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po'i rnam thar gsol 'debs las/ thub bstan spyi dang khyad par rdo rje theg /sngags gzhung spyi dang khyad par snga 'gyur te/ /de nyid spyi dang khyad par bka' ma'i gzhung*/ /dri med phyogs brgyar spel la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes bstod pa bzhin dam pa 'dis dbus gtsang khams khul kun tu mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i dpe lung gi rgyun rnams dang*/ khyad par du kun mkhyen rong zom chos bzang gi gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i dpe rnying rnams 'tshol bsdu gnang ste shing par la bkod pa dang*/ yang sgos su snga 'gyur bka' ma'i dbang lung dang dpe rgyun rnams ni rje 'di nyid kyi bka' drin kho na las ma nyams par byung ba ste/ khong rdzogs chen dgon du bzhugs pa'i skabs shig mnal lam du slob dpon pad ma'i gsung dngos yin zer nas po ti zhig gtad byung ba rmis/ phyir nang grogs mched rnams la slob dpon chen po'i gsung bka' ma'i yig cha yod med 'dri brtsad gnang bas/ sngar man ngag lta phreng rtsa 'grel zhig yod kyang da lta dpe stor nas yun ring song zhes zer/ khong nas dpe mdzod rnams su btsal na rnyed rgyu yod dam dgongs te btsal kyang ma rnyed/ phyis chos khri'i 'og gi sa rdul rnams bsal te gad bdar byas pa'i khrod nas lta phreng gi dpe cha rnyed pa zhib gzigs gnang bas/ tshig don phun sum tshogs par gzigs te nges shes thun mong ma yin pa zhig 'khrungs/ de'i rkyen gyis rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag snga 'gyur bka' ma'i gzhung rnams phyogs sgrig byed rgyu'i thugs 'dun drag po zhig rnyed pa rgyun chags su yod pa'i khar/

lha lung pad ri dgon du zla shas bzhugs skabs rig 'dzin pad+ma dbang rgyal rdo rje dang thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur/ dam pa de nyid kyis sku gsung thugs rten gtso bor gyur pa'i dngos rdzas du ma'i 'bul ba dang bcas te/ snga 'gyur bka' ma'i dbang lung dang dpe rgyun rnams phyogs bsdu byed par yang yang bskul ba dang*/ kong yul nga phod mi rje'i gdung rgyud zla ba tshe brtan rgyal pos kyang bskul ma zhus/ slad nas o rgyan smin grol gling gi gdung 'dzin khri rab drug pa/ 'gyur med sangs rgyas kun dga'i zhal snga nas kyang yang yang bskul ba dang*/ gzhan yang dbus phyogs su bzhugs yod pa'i skabs shig gi mnal lam du/ rje nyid kyi ma yum de yin snyam pa'i bud med zhig gis ltos dang zer ba la gzigs pas/ gang snang thams cad yig 'bru che phra mang pos gang nas khra chem chem 'dug pa la/ bud med des gser gyi rdo rje 'od 'bar ba zhig mdun thad gyi nam mkhar lan gsum 'phangs ba'i mthar bar snang der rten med du bsdad song ba de la/ sdigs mdzub kyi brda thabs gang du bstan pa'i phyogs der hril hril 'gro ba zhig gzigs pas/ rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa la ri mor gyis shig ces mkha' 'gros brdas bskul bar thugs su chud de/ snga 'gyur bka' ma'i skor gyi dpe rgyun dkon rigs rnams dbus gtsang kun tu btsal kyang ma rnyed par yod pa'i tshe/ smin gling du bzhugs skabs cha shas tsam 'di ga'i dpe mdzod du yod zer ba zhig gzims lam byung ba sogs/ lha dang srung mas bskul ba'i gzigs snang mang po byung bas/ khams dbus kun tu bzhugs pa'i dpe lung gi rgyun rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus te shing par la bkod gnang mdzad pa ni/ rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par snga 'gyur ba'i bstan pa rin po che la/ kha tsam ma yin par snying nas gces pa'i gang zag chos spyan ldan pa rnams kyis dam pa 'di'i bka' drin shes shing dran par bya 'os so/

/rje 'di sku tshe mthar phyin par bzhugs na bstan pa'i mnga' thang dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas pa gor ma chag kyang*/ de lta bu 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyis ma thub par dgung grangs lnga bcu nga lnga rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i shing yos spyi lo 1855par zhing gzhan du gshegs so/ / slob ma/ dpal sprul rin po che/ mkhan po pad+ma rdo rje/ zhe chen paṇ+ḍi ta mthu stobs rnam rgyal/ smin gling khri chen sangs rgyas kun dga'/ rdo rje brag rig 'dzin chen po/ lha lung pad ri sprul sku/ bla ma pad+ma dam chos 'od zer sogs mang po byon/ gsung 'bum la/ sum rtags kyi 'grel pa dang*/ rab byung gzhi chog/ phung lnga'i rab dbye/ gsang snying spyi don kun bzang thugs kyi ti ka /gsang snying khog dbub/ gsung mgur zhal gdams sogs chos tshan brgyad cu la pod gnyis bzhugs/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/ 2008 lo'i zla 6 tshes 10 nyin la/ rtsom pa po'i rnam thar/rtsom pa po'i rnam thar/ -PAGE 2--PAGE 3--PAGE 1-
